claims.claim: Ting-Wei Sun pleaded guilty under an agreement with prosecutors to charges tied to diverting Super Micro servers with Nvidia AI chips to China, with cooperation terms undisclosed and sentencing expected on September 8, 2027.
claims.episode_span: Ting-Wei "Willy" Sun, a third-party broker, pleaded guilty under an agreement with prosecutors
claims.source_title: Super Micro smuggling co-conspirator pleads guilty to sending AI chips to China
claims.supporting_quote: Ting-Wei “Willy” Sun, a third-party broker and “fixer” who’s been charged alongside Super Micro co-founder Yih-Shyan “Wally” Liaw and sales manager Ruei-Tsang “Steven” Chang for conspiring to unlawfully divert Nvidia AI chips to China, has pleaded guilty to the allegations against him.

claims.claim: The reported diversion used a Southeast Asian company, dummy servers, hair dryers to transfer serial numbers, and a Thailand-based corporation that delivered servers to Alibaba, which denied receiving the hardware.
claims.episode_span: workers used hair dryers to move serial numbers onto those shells
claims.source_title: Super Micro smuggling co-conspirator pleads guilty to sending AI chips to China
claims.supporting_quote: Workers then used hair dryers to remove the serial numbers on the real servers to transfer them to the dummy server shells to complete the illusion, while the real servers made their way to China.

claims.claim: Super Micro denied knowledge of the operation, which the report says netted $2.5 billion in sales since it started in 2024, and shareholders have sued alleging concealment of illicit China sales.
claims.episode_span: the report puts sales since the activity began in 2024 at $2.5 billion
claims.source_title: Super Micro smuggling co-conspirator pleads guilty to sending AI chips to China
claims.supporting_quote: Super Micro has also denied any knowledge of the operation, even as it has netted $2.5 billion in sales since it started in 2024.

claims.claim: Wally Liaw pleaded not guilty, was released on a $5 million bond, and is set for trial on November 2, while Steven Chang remains a fugitive.
claims.episode_span: Liaw has pleaded not guilty, is free on a $5 million bond, and is set for trial on November 2
claims.source_title: Super Micro smuggling co-conspirator pleads guilty to sending AI chips to China
claims.supporting_quote: Liaw, on the other hand, has pleaded not guilty to the charges and was released on a $5 million bond.

claims.claim: Taiwan indicted nine more people over illegal smuggling of Nvidia B300 GPUs, while Super Micro said it cooperated, provided workstation access, fired employees, and denied that its premises were raided.
claims.episode_span: Taiwan has indicted nine more people over illegal shipments of Nvidia B300 GPUs
claims.source_title: Super Micro smuggling co-conspirator pleads guilty to sending AI chips to China
claims.supporting_quote: Soon after this, Taiwan indicted nine more people involved in the illegal smuggling of Nvidia B300 GPUs.

claims.claim: SK hynix is continuing a share repurchase while widening HBM production, and Solidigm is expanding manufacturing in Taiwan in a move media reports tie to data-centre SSD demand.
claims.episode_span: SK hynix is continuing a sizable share repurchase while widening its high-bandwidth memory production footprint.
claims.source_title: SK Hynix Buyback Rolls On as IBK and Bernstein Diverge on HBM Pricing
claims.supporting_quote: SK Hynix is pressing ahead with its sizable share repurchase program while simultaneously widening its high-bandwidth memory production footprint

claims.claim: On October 1 SK hynix said no decisions had been reached on capital plans for its NAND unit, and reports of a roughly $10 billion U.S. listing for Solidigm arranged with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are unconfirmed by the company.
claims.episode_span: On October 1 the parent said no decisions have been reached on capital plans for the NAND unit
claims.source_title: SK Hynix Buyback Rolls On as IBK and Bernstein Diverge on HBM Pricing
claims.supporting_quote: The parent stated on October 1 that no decisions have been reached on capital plans for the NAND unit, adding that it is weighing various options and will measure them against the interests of existing shareholders and long-term corporate value.

claims.claim: Bernstein analyst Mark Li cited more conservative HBM pricing assumptions, anticipated Samsung market-share gains, and reported supply difficulties with HBM4.
claims.episode_span: Bernstein analyst Mark Li cited more conservative HBM pricing assumptions, anticipated market-share gains by Samsung, and reported supply difficulties with the coming HBM4 generation.
claims.source_title: SK Hynix Buyback Rolls On as IBK and Bernstein Diverge on HBM Pricing
claims.supporting_quote: The firm cited more conservative assumptions on HBM pricing, anticipated market-share gains by rival Samsung, and reported supply difficulties with the coming HBM4 generation.

claims.claim: A Yandex facility in Kaluga had multiple modules completely out of service after a Ukrainian drone strike, the second such strike on a Russian data centre in two days after one in Sasovo, and the headline describes a 1.4-million-square-foot campus.
claims.episode_span: a Yandex facility in Kaluga, with multiple modules completely out of service, after a strike on a data centre in Sasovo
claims.source_title: Ukrainian drones strike largest data center in Russia, multiple parts of 1.4 million square foot campus knocked offline
claims.supporting_quote: Following a Ukrainian drone strike on a D.C. in Sasovo, Russia, a Yandex facility in Kaluga has suffered a similar fate with multiple modules completely out of service.

claims.claim: Cipher extended Barber Lake data-centre lease commitments to 20 years, with Fluidstack and an unnamed AI lab agreeing lengthy leases.
claims.episode_span: Cipher has extended lease commitments at the Barber Lake data centre to 20 years.
claims.source_title: Cipher extends Barber Lake data center lease commitments to 20 years
claims.supporting_quote: Fluidstack and unnamed AI lab agree lengthy leases

claims.claim: Reports say Tencent agreed to lease about 100,000 high-performance AI chips from Oracle for $7 billion over five years, with per-hour cost estimated about 43 percent under an H100 leased at $2.80 per hour on a one-year contract, and the chips unnamed but pointing toward Hopper-class.
claims.episode_span: Tencent has reached a deal to lease high-performance AI chips from Oracle, about 100,000 chips for $7 billion over five years.
claims.source_title: This week on Tom's Hardware Premium: October 10, 2026
claims.supporting_quote: Reports state that Tencent has reached a deal to lease high-performance AI chips from Oracle to the tune of $7 billion over five years.

claims.claim: SPEC released SPECviewperf 15.0.1 Linux Edition, its first Linux Edition in almost half a decade, with native Arm AArch64 support and 8 of the Windows suite's 11 benchmarks.
claims.episode_span: SPEC has released SPECviewperf 15.0.1 Linux Edition, the first Linux Edition in almost half a decade.
claims.source_title: SPECviewperf 15.0.1 Linux Edition Released: Linux’s Key Graphics Benchmark Adds Arm Support
claims.supporting_quote: Now up to version 15.0.1 and the group’s first Linux Edition release in almost half a decade, the new release gives the Linux graphics benchmark a significant facelift in both the features it offers and the workloads it tests.
